alex: heads up — ran a full nsys trace on the fused-prefetch attention path and we have a weird KV-cache write/read sync hotspot when batch sizes vary. reproducer attached in the trace.

ryan: can you paste the timeline snippet? :eyes:

alex: pasted below. noisy but the pattern is clear: 1) fused-prefetch kernel launches, 2) KV_READ kernels spin-wait, 3) KV_WRITE bursts then long idle. nsys shows a KV_WRITE stall ~42% of GPU time and SM occupancy dropping to ~32%.

alex: ```
nsys timeline:
[0.00s] fused_prefetch_attn_kern (sm 0..3)
[0.004s] kv_read_lane (sm 0..3) — waiting on memory
[0.006s] kv_write_coalesce (sm 0..3) — heavy L2 bw
[0.012s] idle / cpu sync

metric: KV_WRITE_STALL_PCT=42
L2_BW_SPIKE=~1.8GB/s per SM
SM_OCCUPANCY=32%
```

maria: interesting. did you run with the kv cache in pinned mode or fallback CPU-sync?

alex: pinned GPU pages. this repros only on sequences with long past context + mixed batch lengths (one short request in a batch with others long). looks like fused prefetch merges writes aggressively and causes serialization with reads from the short sample.

ryan: can you share the exact nsys command and the commit? i'll replay locally.

alex: `nsys profile -o /tmp/attn_fuse --trace=cuda,osrt -w true --stats true --sample=none --capture-range=nvtx`
commit: 3b9f2d8 (fused-prefetch heuristics tweak)

ci-bot: perf-regression-alert: test/attn_fused_prefetch_kv (latency_p95) increased by 18% vs baseline on commit 3b9f2d8 :warning:

maria: that matches. CI flagged it on canary yesterday. My theory: the kernel selection heuristic prefers fused-prefetch for batched workloads because it reduces DRAM reads, but when a short sequence is co-batched it triggers frequent small KV writes which blocks long-running reads due to KV metadata locks.

ryan: sounds plausible. two quick checks: 1) repro with `--batch=dynamic` vs `--batch=fixed`, 2) try disabling write coalescing in the kernel (cheap guard) to see if stalls vanish.

alex: did both. dynamic batch still repros. disabling coalescing drops KV_WRITE_STALL_PCT to ~8% and p95 latency back to baseline. so coalescing is the likely culprit.

maria: maybe the fused-prefetch path accidentally uses a global mutex for KV index updates when writes are small — we should audit the write path. also check L2 evictions; small writes might thrash L2 and evict KV read working set.

ryan: i'll add a small nvprof run to capture per-kernel l2_hit/l2_miss and atomic replay counts. command imho: `nvprof --print-gpu-trace --kernels "kv_*|fused_*" ./runner`

alex: nvprof output (trimmed):
```
Kernel: kv_write_coalesce | time 5.9ms | l2_reads 1.2M | l2_writes 620k | atomic_insts 18k
Kernel: kv_read_lane      | time 1.4ms | l2_reads 2.8M | l2_writes 10k  | atomic_insts 2k
```

maria: atomic_insts on writes are suspiciously high for small-writes case. could be an index update loop doing atomics per entry. if fused-prefetch coalesces across lanes it might amplify contention.

ryan: mitigation options: 1) short-term: disable write coalescing for fused-prefetch when batch contains sequences below threshold; 2) mid-term: refactor KV write to use per-SM buffers + single commit (reduce atomics); 3) long-term: change kernel selection heuristic to avoid fused-prefetch for highly heterogeneous batch length distributions.

alex: agreed. i'd like to do (1) + (2) as the rollout plan. we can canary (1) quickly. (2) needs design/bench.

perf-bot: created perf-issue #PF-4732: "fused-prefetch KV write coalescing causes KV_READ/WRITE sync stalls" assigned to @ryan and @maria. labels: regression, p0, perf.

maria: i'll follow up with a small microbenchmark that exercises mixed lengths and provide a patch for conditional coalescing. also instrument NVTX regions around KV commit to make future traces clearer.

ryan: i'll prototype the per-SM buffer refactor branch and run cluster-wide perf tests. will post a short flamegraph + perfetto link here once ready.

alex: thanks. action items: alex - collect perf traces for 3 more runs (different GPUs), maria - draft conditional coalescing patch, ryan - prototype per-SM commit. canary plan: roll fused-prefetch off for canary if PF-4732 p95 goes up >10%.

maria: noted. adding a quick patch to disable coalescing when `min_seq_len_in_batch < 32`. will open PR by EOD.

ryan: ping me on the PR @ryan, i'll bench on A100v4 and H100.

alex: awesome. thanks team :thumbsup:

ci-bot: linked CI runs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/3b9f2d8/attn_fuse_profile

alex: attaching the nsys capture and small perf notes to PF-4732.

maria: will post nvprof + perfetto links in the ticket after upload.

ryan: quick note — if anyone hits this in prod, set `REDWOOD_ATTEN_PREFETCH=legacy` as emergency rollback.

alex: noted and documented in incident playbook.

perf-bot: closing the thread automsg: monitoring alarm registered for metric `attn_fuse.kv_write_stall_pct`.
